how_to_apply: Visit the official UPSSSC website, upsssc.gov.in.
Go to the "Live Advertisement" section on the homepage and open the relevant advertisement (Advt. No. 21-Pareeksha/2026).
Log in using your PET-2025 registration number and the OTP sent to your registered mobile number/email.
Verify your auto-filled personal details (from your PET-2025 application) and select the post(s) you wish to apply for.
Fill in your educational qualification details (board/university, year of passing, roll number, etc.) for the selected post.
Enter the verification code and submit to generate your application number.
View your photo and signature (carried over from PET-2025; these cannot be changed here) and proceed.
Fill in any preferential qualification details and your correspondence address.
Read and accept the declaration, then click "Save and Submit."
Pay the application fee online (Credit/Debit Card, Net Banking, UPI, or SBI e-Challan), download your submitted application form, and keep a printout for future reference.

content_sections.heading: UPSSSC Senior Instructor Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The notification states that no application or fee will be accepted after 5 October 2026. Candidates must complete bank reconciliation of their fee by 5 October 2026, or within 7 days after that (by 12 October 2026), to be able to print their application form.

content_sections.heading: UPSSSC Senior Instructor Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: The 132 posts are spread across 13 disciplines under the Senior Instructor cadre. Category-wise reservation is applied as per Uttar Pradesh government norms. All 132 posts are permanent (Sthayi). Horizontal reservation is also available for divyangjan (persons with disabilities), women, dependents of freedom fighters, ex-servicemen, and outstanding sportspersons, as detailed in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: UPSSSC Senior Instructor Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: To apply for UPSSSC Senior Instructor Recruitment 2026, candidates must have appeared in the Preliminary Eligibility Test (PET) 2025 and hold a valid score card issued by the Commission. Shortlisting for the Main Examination is done post-wise, category-wise, at 15 times the number of vacancies, based on the normalized PET-2025 score. Candidates with a zero or negative normalized/absolute PET-2025 score will not be shortlisted.

content_sections.heading: UPSSSC Senior Instructor Qualification
content_sections.text: Educational qualification requirements vary by discipline, as specified in the notification: Preferential (Adhimani) qualifications - such as experience in the relevant field, service in the Territorial Army, or an NCC 'B' certificate - are also listed post-wise in the official notification and can give an advantage among otherwise equally qualified candidates.

rows.essential_qualification_as_per_notificat: Bachelor's degree in Agricultural Engineering with at least 50% marks
B.V.Sc. or M.V.Sc. (Animal Husbandry) with at least 50% marks
B.Sc. in Home Science / Home Economics / Nutrition / Diet with at least 50% marks
M.A. (Economics) / M.Sc. (Agricultural Economics) / M.Com with at least 50% marks
M.A. (Economics) / M.Sc. (Agricultural Economics) / M.A. (Sociology) with at least 50% marks
Postgraduate degree in Agriculture from a university established by law in India, with at least 55% marks
Graduate degree along with a Sanitary Inspector examination certificate recognized by the State Government
Degree/Diploma in Agricultural/Mechanical/Electrical/Civil Engineering with at least 2 years of relevant experience

content_sections.heading: UPSSSC Senior Instructor Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum age: 21 years Maximum age: 40 years Age reckoning date: 1 July of the calendar year in which the post is advertised/notified Age relaxation is applicable to candidates from Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and other categories notified by the Uttar Pradesh government from time to time, as per prevailing rules. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: UPSSSC Senior Instructor Application Fee
content_sections.text: Dependents of freedom fighters, ex-servicemen, women, divyangjan, and outstanding sportspersons pay the fee applicable to their original category (1 to 4 above). Fee can be paid via Credit Card/Debit Card/Internet Banking/UPI or SBI e-Challan only. The Main Examination fee (for those shortlisted) has to be paid separately before downloading the Main Exam admit card; the fee amount for the Main Exam is not specified in this notification.

content_sections.heading: UPSSSC Senior Instructor Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be placed at Pay Level-6 of the UP government pay matrix, with a pay range of ₹35,400 (minimum) to ₹112,400 (maximum). The notification does not specify the exact gross monthly salary, allowances, or in-hand pay.

content_sections.heading: UPSSSC Senior Instructor Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based solely on performance in the Main Written Examination. There is no interview. Key points: Shortlisting for the Main Exam is done using the normalized PET-2025 score (post-wise, category-wise, at 15 times the vacancies). The Main Exam consists of 100 objective-type, multiple-choice questions worth 100 marks, to be completed in 2 hours (120 minutes). Negative marking applies: 25% (¼) of the marks allotted to a question is deducted for each wrong answer.

content_sections.heading: UPSSSC Senior Instructor Apply Online: Key Points to Remember
content_sections.text: Only online applications will be accepted; no other mode is allowed. Only candidates with a valid PET-2025 score card can apply. Candidates can select multiple posts they are eligible for; if a post is not selected, a claim for it will not be considered later. Once the application fee is successfully paid, the form is auto-submitted and can be downloaded/printed. Applications can be modified only until 12 October 2026, and only for limited fields (educational qualification-related entries); details like address, EWS/horizontal category, gender, and marital status cannot be changed after final submission. Only one application is allowed; if multiple applications are submitted, only the last submitted one is considered valid.

faq.question: Q1. What is UPSSSC Senior Instructor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) to fill 132 Senior Instructor (Jyeshtha Anudeshak) posts under the Deendayal Upadhyay State Rural Development Institute, Bakshi Ka Talab, Lucknow, through Advertisement No. 21-Pareeksha/2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in UPSSSC Senior Instructor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 132 total vacancies across 13 disciplines, including Agricultural Engineering, Plant Protection, Horticulture, Animal Husbandry, Agronomy, Women Welfare, Cooperation, Panchayat, Soil Science, Agriculture, Agricultural Extension, Public Health, and Production.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for UPSSSC Senior Instructor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application and pay the fee is 5 October 2026. Fee reconciliation and application correction can be done until 12 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for UPSSSC Senior Instructor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification requirements vary by post - mostly a bachelor's degree (B.Sc./B.V.Sc.) in the relevant discipline with at least 50% marks, or a postgraduate degree for the Agriculture post. See the qualification table above for post-wise details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for UPSSSC Senior Instructor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 21 and 40 years of age as on 1 July of the calendar year of the notification, with age relaxation for reserved categories as per Uttar Pradesh government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for UPSSSC Senior Instructor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The total fee is ₹25 (₹0 exam fee + ₹25 online processing fee) for all categories - Unreserved, OBC, SC, and ST.
